speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the update. To better understand your condition, please describe your specific symptoms: Do you have a headache, neck stiffness, or any focal weakness? Also, have you experienced seizures or confusion?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS) secondary to haloperidol use.
